next.reason: 1985 fixes the size of the NUMVAL-C result: 'The number of digits returned is 18.' No 2023 rule fixes a returned digit count. §2023:15.68.4 RV1 ('The returned value is the numeric value represented by argument-1') restates 1985 RV1, and §2023:15.68.3 AR6/AR7 restate 1985 AR3's limit on argument-1 digits (31/35/34), so neither states this requirement. Instead §2023:15.4.1 says 'When native arithmetic is in effect, the characteristics and representation of the returned value are defined by the implementor.' That paragraph has no catalog id. The fixed 18-digit size is therefore dropped. A conforming 1985 argument has at most 18 digits, so its value is the same.
